about.title: About the project
about.intro:
Fabrica L is a creative hub for business and events.

By bringing together representatives of the creative industries, we create a new creative community in Dnipro.

We revitalize the former Hats Factory in Dnipro and give this building a new function, preserving the industrial aesthetics.

On an area of more than 11 thousand square meters, we create conditions for commercial and social initiatives aimed at the development of the new economy, modern art, non-formal education, etc.

Fabrica L is the largest such center in the Dnipro region.
about.card1Desc: Fabrica L is a reboot idea, a place for people to self-actualize and a reason to stay in the city.
about.card2Desc: The project brings together a community of people with similar values, stimulates to find solutions to problems together, provides access to talents and unique expertise.
